purpose: Supplemental manufacturer facts for the next bounded batch. Not imported by the storefront and never an approval. Existing 28 review facts remain unchanged.

products.name: Le Male Le Parfum
products.variant_evidence: Official product heading states Eau de Parfum Intense; size selector explicitly includes 125 ml. Reference is a manufacturer page reference, not a verified GTIN.
products.summary_de: Kardamom eröffnet den Duft. Lavendel und Iris bilden das Herz, Vanille die Basis.
products.caveat: Legacy research candidate abbreviates concentration to Eau de Parfum; exact staging already correctly says Eau de Parfum Intense. Do not create a second product.

products.name: Spicebomb Extreme
products.variant_evidence: Official product title explicitly identifies Eau de Parfum 90ml; US page also selects 90 ml.
products.summary_de: Lavendel und Gewürznoten treffen auf Tabak, Bourbon und Vanille.
products.caveat: Use only the manufacturer's Key Notes list. Its separate note graphics use a different selection; no unified complete pyramid is inferred.

products.name: Guidance 46
products.variant_evidence: Official page identifies Guidance 46 Exceptional Extrait and 100ml. Manufacturer designation Extrait corresponds to the staged Extrait de Parfum; not Guidance Eau de Parfum.
products.summary_de: Birne, Haselnuss und Weihrauch führen zu einem floralen Herzen mit Safran. Sandelholz, Vanille und weitere Holznoten bilden die Basis.

products.name: Chloé
products.variant_evidence: Title and Product Details identify Eau de Parfum 100 ml and item code CHCA50133819. The separately mentioned 150 ml refill is not this variant.
products.summary_de: Pfingstrose eröffnet das florale Profil. Rosenblätter und Magnolie treffen auf Zeder und Ambra.

products.name: Valaya Exclusif
products.variant_evidence: Official page title identifies Eau de Parfum 75 ml; selected product size is 75ml. Distinct from Valaya and the hair perfume.
products.summary_de: Mandel und Zitrusnoten eröffnen das Profil. Weiße Blüten und pudrige Facetten führen zu Sandelholz, Ambroxan und Vanille.

products.name: MYSLF Le Parfum
products.variant_evidence: Official MYSLF Le Parfum page selects 100 ml. Numeric URL reference remains manufacturer_reference, not verified GTIN; not MYSLF Eau de Parfum.
products.summary_de: Schwarzer Pfeffer trifft auf Orangenblüten-Absolue. Holznoten und Bourbon-Vanille bilden den Ausklang.

products.name: Sauvage Elixir
products.variant_evidence: Official Sauvage Elixir page includes 100 ml. Preserve the manufacturer's Elixir designation, do not reinterpret it as a percentage or Eau de Parfum.
products.summary_de: Grapefruit und Gewürze treffen auf Lavendel. Lakritz, Vetiver und Patschuli ergänzen den holzig-ambrierten Duftcharakter.

products.name: Side Effect
products.variant_evidence: Official heading states EAU DE PARFUM with 90ML product option. Hair perfume and travel bundle are separately linked, not this variant.
products.summary_de: Zimt, Rum und Tabak prägen das Profil. Safran, Sandelholz und Hedione ergänzen die dokumentierten Hauptnoten.
products.caveat: Main Notes section used verbatim as factual note names; no performance or attraction claims from marketing copy adopted.

products.name: La Nuit de L'Homme
products.variant_evidence: Official Eau de Toilette page selects 100 ml. Not the separately listed Eau de Parfum or Le Parfum.
products.summary_de: Bergamotte eröffnet den Duft, gefolgt von Zedernholz und Lavendel. Vetiver bildet die Basis.
products.caveat: Only the dedicated Olfaktion description supplies this pyramid; unrelated Bleu Electrique SEO keywords and ingredient-list allergens are not treated as notes.

products.name: Acqua di Giò Profondo
products.variant_evidence: Official Profondo Parfum page offers 100 ml; not Profondo Eau de Parfum. Volume selector explicitly distinguishes 30/50/100/200 ml.
products.summary_de: Marine Noten und Bergamotte eröffnen das Profil. Immortelle führt zu Zistrosen-Absolue und Patschuli.
products.caveat: Uses the three labeled note headings for Profondo Parfum only, not the adjacent comparison cards for other Acqua di Giò variants.

products.name: Sì
products.variant_evidence: Official Sì Eau de Parfum selector offers 100 ml separately from Refill 100ml. Neither Intense nor Passione.
products.summary_de: Schwarzer Johannisbeernektar führt zu einem modernen Chypre-Akkord. Ein Moschus-Weißholz-Akkord bildet die Basis.

products.name: 9 PM Pour Femme
products.variant_evidence: Official 9 PM Pour Femme page states Type Eau De Perfum and Volume 100 ML. Spelling normalized to Eau de Parfum; distinct from the men's 9PM.
products.summary_de: Fruchtige Noten von Himbeere, Apfel und Orange treffen auf Veilchen und ein florales Herz. Zeder, Zypresse, Kiefer und Ambra bilden die Basis.

products.name: J’adore
products.variant_evidence: Official J’adore Eau de Parfum page explicitly states Inhalt 100 ml. New bottle collar is described; no assumption that older bottle images match this presentation.
products.summary_de: Ylang-Ylang und Damaszener-Rose verbinden sich mit großblütigem und arabischem Jasmin zu einem floralen Profil.

products.reason: Official page confirms 100 ML and notes, but extracted text does not state concentration. Description mentions jasmine absent from its note pyramid. Need explicit Eau de Parfum evidence and a scoped note policy before qualification.
Current official comparison lists Le Male Pride 2026 EDT 125 ml; that is not proof of the staged Fleur du Mâle (2026) identity. Do not conflate names or reuse older discontinued product evidence.
Retail search confirms the target 100 ml EDP Intense, but no original manufacturer page was verified in this batch. Retailer listing alone is not the requested original manufacturer evidence.
Specific 2025 edition identity remains unverified in this batch. Do not silently map an undated current The One Eau de Parfum page to an edition-specific staged record.
